text:
Type: black picture frame with white mat
Use: displaying photos, prints or posters on a wall or shelf; living room, home office, hallway, bedroom
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, modern
Materials: wood-look frame in a matte black finish, white mat board, clear glazing
Colors: matte black, white mat, light grey insert
Shape: tall rectangle with a slim flat profile, wide white mat around the picture, clean square corners, simple and light visual weight
Feel: graphic, tidy, calm
Goes with: white or grey walls, black accents, light wood; Scandinavian, minimalist or modern gallery walls

product.name: RIBBA
product.description: The mount enhances the picture and makes framing easy.
